question:
After a femoral angioplasty the arterial sheath is in place. The nurse should:

फीमोरल एंजियोप्लास्टी के बाद धमनी शीथ लगी हुई है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Keep the limb straight and monitor the puncture site and distal pulses
अंग को सीधा रखें और पंचर स्थल तथा दूरस्थ नाड़ी की निगरानी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The limb is kept straight and the site and distal pulses are observed until the sheath is removed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Encourage early walking
जल्दी चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें: Early walking can cause bleeding from the puncture

B — Massage the puncture site
पंचर स्थल की मालिश करें: Massaging the site triggers bleeding

C — Remove the sheath at once
शीथ को तुरंत निकाल दें: Removing the sheath at once risks bleeding

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for a haematoma, bleeding and a loss of the distal pulse, and keep the patient on bed rest as ordered
option_1:
Encourage early walking
जल्दी चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें
option_2:
Massage the puncture site
पंचर स्थल की मालिश करें
option_3:
Remove the sheath at once
शीथ को तुरंत निकाल दें
option_4:
Keep the limb straight and monitor the puncture site and distal pulses
अंग को सीधा रखें और पंचर स्थल तथा दूरस्थ नाड़ी की निगरानी करें

question:
A patient regains a pulse after cardiac arrest and remains unconscious. The nurse should:

कार्डियक अरेस्ट के बाद रोगी की नाड़ी लौट आई है पर वह अचेतन है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Maintain the airway, give oxygen and monitor the rhythm and blood pressure closely
वायुमार्ग बनाए रखें, ऑक्सीजन दें और लय तथा रक्तचाप की निगरानी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: After return of circulation, the airway, oxygenation, rhythm and pressure are supported and monitored

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give oral fluids
मुँह से तरल दें: Oral fluids are unsafe in an unconscious patient

B — Stop monitoring the heart
हृदय की निगरानी बंद कर दें: Continuous monitoring is essential for recurrence

D — Sit the patient up
रोगी को बैठा दें: Sitting up worsens cerebral perfusion

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Aim for good oxygenation and blood pressure, because the brain is recovering from hypoxia
option_2:
Stop monitoring the heart
हृदय की निगरानी बंद कर दें
option_3:
Maintain the airway, give oxygen and monitor the rhythm and blood pressure closely
वायुमार्ग बनाए रखें, ऑक्सीजन दें और लय तथा रक्तचाप की निगरानी करें
option_4:
Sit the patient up
रोगी को बैठा दें

question:
Which step is correct when using a metered-dose inhaler with a spacer?

स्पेसर के साथ मीटर्ड-डोज इनहेलर का उपयोग करते समय कौन-सा चरण सही है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Shake the inhaler, breathe out, then press and breathe in slowly
इनहेलर को हिलाएँ, साँस छोड़ें, फिर दबाएँ और धीरे-धीरे साँस लें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The inhaler is shaken, the breath is let out, then the dose is released as the patient breathes in slowly and deeply

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Breathe in very fast
बहुत तेजी से साँस लें: Breathing too fast deposits the drug in the mouth

B — Hold the breath for only one second
केवल एक सेकंड साँस रोकें: The breath is held for about ten seconds

C — Press the inhaler while breathing out
साँस छोड़ते समय इनहेलर दबाएँ: Pressing while breathing out wastes the drug

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Rinse the mouth after a steroid inhaler to prevent oral thrush
option_1:
Breathe in very fast
बहुत तेजी से साँस लें
option_2:
Hold the breath for only one second
केवल एक सेकंड साँस रोकें
option_3:
Press the inhaler while breathing out
साँस छोड़ते समय इनहेलर दबाएँ
option_4:
Shake the inhaler, breathe out, then press and breathe in slowly
इनहेलर को हिलाएँ, साँस छोड़ें, फिर दबाएँ और धीरे-धीरे साँस लें

question:
A patient has a straw-coloured pleural aspirate with a high protein content and a positive tuberculosis history. The nurse should:

रोगी के फुस्फुस आकर्षण में भूसे-रंग का द्रव, अधिक प्रोटीन और तपेदिक का इतिहास है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Record the amount, send the sample as ordered and start the prescribed antitubercular treatment
मात्रा दर्ज करें, आदेश अनुसार नमूना भेजें और निर्धारित तपेदिक उपचार शुरू करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The aspirate is measured and sent for testing while the prescribed antitubercular therapy begins

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Restrict all fluids
सभी तरल रोक दें: Fluids are not restricted in this situation

C — Encourage deep breathing only
केवल गहरी साँस लेने को कहें: Deep breathing helps but is not sufficient alone

D — Ignore the fluid
द्रव को नजरअंदाज करें: Ignoring the effusion allows it to worsen

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for breathlessness and for the effusion to reaccumulate, and encourage adherence to the full course
option_2:
Record the amount, send the sample as ordered and start the prescribed antitubercular treatment
मात्रा दर्ज करें, आदेश अनुसार नमूना भेजें और निर्धारित तपेदिक उपचार शुरू करें
option_3:
Encourage deep breathing only
केवल गहरी साँस लेने को कहें

question:
A patient with hypothyroidism is likely to have:

हाइपोथायरायडिज्म वाले रोगी में क्या पाया जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Weight gain, cold intolerance and constipation
वजन बढ़ना, ठंड असहनशीलता और कब्ज

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Hypothyroidism causes weight gain, cold intolerance and constipation from a slow metabolism

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Increased sweating
अधिक पसीना: Excessive sweating suggests hyperthyroidism

B — Tachycardia and tremor
तेज़ हृदयगति और कंपन: Tachycardia and tremor suggest hyperthyroidism

D — Weight loss and heat intolerance
वजन घटना और गर्मी असहनशीलता: Weight loss and heat intolerance suggest hyperthyroidism

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Levothyroxine is taken on an empty stomach and the thyroid level is monitored
option_3:
Weight gain, cold intolerance and constipation
वजन बढ़ना, ठंड असहनशीलता और कब्ज
option_4:
Weight loss and heat intolerance
वजन घटना और गर्मी असहनशीलता

question:
Exophthalmos is commonly seen in:

एक्सोफ्थैल्मोस सामान्यतः किसमें देखा जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease)
हाइपरथायरायडिज्म (ग्रेव्स रोग)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Bulging eyes, or exophthalmos, is a feature of Graves' disease

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Addison's disease
एडिसन रोग: Addison's disease causes weakness and pigmentation

B — Hypothyroidism
हाइपोथायरायडिज्म: Hypothyroidism causes puffy, dull features

D — Diabetes mellitus
मधुमेह: Diabetes affects glucose control

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Protect the eyes with lubricants and sunglasses, because the lids may not close fully

question:
A patient has sudden severe epigastric pain with a board-like rigid abdomen. The nurse should:

रोगी को अचानक तेज़ एपिगैस्ट्रिक दर्द और फट्टे जैसा कठोर पेट है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Keep the patient nil by mouth and prepare for urgent surgery with intravenous fluids and analgesia
रोगी को कुछ भी मुँह से न दें और अंतःशिरा द्रव तथा दर्द निवारक के साथ आपात शल्य चिकित्सा की तैयारी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Rigidity with sudden severe pain suggests a perforated ulcer, needing nil-by-mouth and urgent surgery

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give oral fluids
मुँह से तरल दें: Oral fluids worsen the peritoneal contamination

C — Apply a hot water bag
गर्म पानी की थैली लगाएँ: Heat increases inflammation

D — Give a laxative
जुलाब दें: A laxative is dangerous

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Monitor the vital signs for shock, because peritonitis causes large fluid shifts
option_2:
Keep the patient nil by mouth and prepare for urgent surgery with intravenous fluids and analgesia
रोगी को कुछ भी मुँह से न दें और अंतःशिरा द्रव तथा दर्द निवारक के साथ आपात शल्य चिकित्सा की तैयारी करें
option_3:
Apply a hot water bag
गर्म पानी की थैली लगाएँ

question:
A patient with cirrhosis becomes drowsy and confused. The nurse should:

सिरोसिस वाला रोगी सुस्त और भ्रमित हो जाता है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Report it as it may be hepatic encephalopathy, and give prescribed lactulose
इसे हेपेटिक एन्सेफलोपैथी बताते हुए रिपोर्ट करें और निर्धारित लैक्टुलोज़ दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Confusion in cirrhosis suggests hepatic encephalopathy, treated with lactulose and review of protein intake

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Ignore the change
परिवर्तन को नजरअंदाज करें: Ignoring mental change is unsafe

C — Restrict fluids
तरल रोक दें: Fluids are not the main issue

D — Increase dietary protein freely
आहार में प्रोटीन बढ़ा दें: Sudden protein loading can worsen encephalopathy

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Excess ammonia from an untreatable build-up causes the confusion, so lactulose is used to clear it
option_1:
Report it as it may be hepatic encephalopathy, and give prescribed lactulose
इसे हेपेटिक एन्सेफलोपैथी बताते हुए रिपोर्ट करें और निर्धारित लैक्टुलोज़ दें
option_4:
Increase dietary protein freely
आहार में प्रोटीन बढ़ा दें

question:
In the oliguric phase of acute kidney injury the nurse should:

तीव्र गुर्दा क्षति के अल्प-मूत्र चरण में नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Monitor intake and output strictly and watch for hyperkalaemia
आवक-जावक की कड़ी निगरानी करें और अति-पोटेशियम पर ध्यान दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Strict fluid balance and monitoring for hyperkalaemia are essential in oliguric renal failure

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Measure only the urine output
केवल मूत्र उत्पादन मापें: Both intake and output must be measured

C — Encourage large fluid intake
अधिक तरल लेने को कहें: Large fluid intake causes overload

D — Give a potassium-rich diet
पोटेशियम-युक्त आहार दें: A potassium-rich diet can cause dangerous arrhythmias

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch the potassium, creatinine and weight daily, because hyperkalaemia and fluid overload are the main dangers
option_1:
Monitor intake and output strictly and watch for hyperkalaemia
आवक-जावक की कड़ी निगरानी करें और अति-पोटेशियम पर ध्यान दें
option_2:
Measure only the urine output
केवल मूत्र उत्पादन मापें
option_3:
Encourage large fluid intake
अधिक तरल लेने को कहें

question:
After a kidney transplant, a patient on immunosuppressants should be taught to:

गुर्दा प्रत्यारोपण के बाद इम्यूनोसप्रेसंट पर रोगी को क्या सिखाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Take the drugs regularly, avoid crowds and report fever or reduced urine
दवाएँ नियमित लें, भीड़ से बचें और बुखार या कम मूत्र होने पर बताएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Regular immunosuppression with infection prevention and early reporting protect the graft

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Skip hand hygiene
हाथ की सफाई छोड़ दें: Hand hygiene prevents infection

B — Stop the drugs when feeling well
अच्छा लगने पर दवाएँ बंद कर दें: Stopping drugs causes rejection

C — Avoid all fluids
सभी तरल से बचें: Fluids should not be avoided

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Signs of rejection include fever, pain over the graft and a fall in urine output, and they need urgent review
option_1:
Skip hand hygiene
हाथ की सफाई छोड़ दें
option_2:
Stop the drugs when feeling well
अच्छा लगने पर दवाएँ बंद कर दें
option_4:
Take the drugs regularly, avoid crowds and report fever or reduced urine
दवाएँ नियमित लें, भीड़ से बचें और बुखार या कम मूत्र होने पर बताएँ

question:
The main treatment for chronic osteomyelitis is:

दीर्घकालिक ऑस्टियोमाइलाइटिस का मुख्य उपचार क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. A prolonged course of appropriate antibiotics, sometimes with surgical debridement
उपयुक्त एंटीबायोटिक का लंबा कोर्स, कभी-कभी शल्य सफाई के साथ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Chronic osteomyelitis needs prolonged antibiotics and often surgical debridement of dead bone

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Heat application only
केवल गर्माहट लगाना: Heat alone does not cure the infection

C — Massage of the affected bone
प्रभावित हड्डी की मालिश: Massage does not help and may cause pain

D — A short course of oral antibiotics
थोड़े समय के लिए मुँह से एंटीबायोटिक: A short course is inadequate and leads to relapse

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Immobilise the limb and support nutrition, because healing takes a long time
option_1:
A prolonged course of appropriate antibiotics, sometimes with surgical debridement
उपयुक्त एंटीबायोटिक का लंबा कोर्स, कभी-कभी शल्य सफाई के साथ
option_3:
Massage of the affected bone
प्रभावित हड्डी की मालिश
option_4:
A short course of oral antibiotics
थोड़े समय के लिए मुँह से एंटीबायोटिक

question:
A patient on methotrexate for rheumatoid arthritis should be monitored for:

रूमेटॉयड आर्थराइटिस के लिए मेथोट्रेक्सेट ले रहे रोगी में किसकी निगरानी करनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Liver and bone marrow toxicity
यकृत और अस्थि मज्जा विषाक्तता

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Methotrexate can damage the liver and suppress the bone marrow, so blood counts and liver tests are monitored

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Polyuria
अधिक मूत्र: Polyuria relates to diuretics or diabetes

B — Hearing loss
सुनने की क्षमता में कमी: Hearing loss relates to aminoglycosides

C — Gum hypertrophy
मसूड़ों की वृद्धि: Gum hypertrophy relates to phenytoin

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Pearl: Folic acid is often given with methotrexate to reduce side effects
option_4:
Liver and bone marrow toxicity
यकृत और अस्थि मज्जा विषाक्तता

question:
Breast self-examination is best performed:

स्तन स्व-परीक्षण कब करना सर्वोत्तम है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. A few days after the period ends
मासिक धर्म समाप्त होने के कुछ दिन बाद

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A few days after the period, when the breasts are least tender and lumpy, is the best time

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — During heavy bleeding
अधिक रक्तस्राव के दौरान: During bleeding the breasts may be tender

B — During pregnancy only
केवल गर्भावस्था में: It is done regularly, not only in pregnancy

C — Only once a year
वर्ष में एक बार: Monthly examination finds changes early

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Any new lump, dimpling or nipple discharge should be reported at once
option_3:
Only once a year
वर्ष में एक बार
option_4:
A few days after the period ends
मासिक धर्म समाप्त होने के कुछ दिन बाद

question:
In the WHO analgesic ladder for cancer pain, strong opioids are used when:

कैंसर दर्द के लिए डब्ल्यूएचओ दर्द-सीढ़ी में कड़ी अफीम-औषधियाँ कब दी जाती हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Moderate pain does not respond to weaker steps
मध्यम दर्द कमजोर चरणों से नियंत्रित न हो

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Strong opioids are added when moderate pain does not respond to the lower steps of the ladder

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only in the last days of life
केवल जीवन के अंतिम दिनों में: Opioids are used whenever needed, not only at the end of life

C — Pain is mild
दर्द हल्का हो: Mild pain is treated with simple analgesics

D — Always as the first step
सदैव पहले चरण के रूप में: The ladder is followed step by step

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Give drugs by the clock, not only on demand, and prevent constipation and nausea
option_1:
Only in the last days of life
केवल जीवन के अंतिम दिनों में
option_2:
Moderate pain does not respond to weaker steps
मध्यम दर्द कमजोर चरणों से नियंत्रित न हो
option_4:
Always as the first step
सदैव पहले चरण के रूप में

question:
Which route gives the highest body temperature reading?

किस मार्ग से शरीर का तापमान सबसे अधिक पढ़ा जाता है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Rectal
मलाशय

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The rectal temperature is about half a degree higher than the oral temperature

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Axillary
बगल: The axillary reading is the lowest

C — Tympanic
कान: The tympanic reading is close to the oral

D — Oral
मुँह: The oral reading is lower than the rectal

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Record the route used, because the same patient's reading differs between routes

question:
During a bed bath, the nurse should wash:

बिस्तर-स्नान के दौरान नर्स को कैसे धोना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. From the cleanest to the dirtiest area, folding the washcloth
सबसे साफ से सबसे गंदे भाग की ओर, कपड़े को मोड़ते हुए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Washing from clean to dirty areas with a folded, rinsed cloth reduces infection and respects dignity

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — With cold water only
केवल ठंडे पानी से: Comfortably warm water is used

C — From the dirtiest to the cleanest area
सबसे गंदे से सबसे साफ भाग की ओर: Dirty-to-clean spreads organisms

D — Without any privacy
गोपनीयता के बिना: Privacy is always maintained

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Expose only the part being washed to keep the patient warm
option_1:
From the cleanest to the dirtiest area, folding the washcloth

question:
The normal adult urine output in 24 hours is about:

वयस्क में 24 घंटे का सामान्य मूत्र उत्पादन कितना होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. 1500 mL
1500 मि.ली.

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The normal adult urine output is about 1500 mL in 24 hours

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 5000 mL
5000 मि.ली.: 5000 mL suggests excessive output

B — 100 to 300 mL
100 से 300 मि.ली.: 100 to 300 mL suggests severe oliguria

D — 500 mL
500 मि.ली.: 500 mL is reduced

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

question:
When giving oral tablets to an adult, the nurse should:

वयस्क को मुँह से गोलियाँ देते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Give them with a small sip of water while the patient is upright
रोगी को सीधा बैठाकर थोड़े पानी के घूँट के साथ दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Tablets are given with water while the patient is upright, to help swallowing and prevent choking

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give them with the patient flat
रोगी को लिटाकर दें: A flat position increases the risk of choking

B — Leave them at the bedside
पलंग के पास छोड़ दें: Leaving medicines at the bedside risks errors

आदेश के बिना सभी गोलियाँ चूर्ण करें: Only scored or approved tablets may be crushed

⚠️ Exam Trap: Remember that delegation transfers the task but never the accountability.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the ability to swallow and keep the patient upright for a short while after

Give them with the patient flat
रोगी को लिटाकर दें

Leave them at the bedside
पलंग के पास छोड़ दें

Crush all tablets without an order
आदेश के बिना सभी गोलियाँ चूर्ण करें

question:
The Z-track technique is used for intramuscular injections to:

अंतःपेशी इंजेक्शन के लिए ज़ेड-ट्रैक तकनीक क्यों प्रयोग की जाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Prevent leakage of the drug into subcutaneous tissue
दवा को चमड़े के नीचे रिसने से रोकने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The Z-track technique seals the track and keeps irritating drugs from leaking into the subcutaneous tissue

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Avoid using gloves
दस्ताने से बचने के लिए: Gloves are always used

C — Speed up the injection
इंजेक्शन तेज़ करने के लिए: It does not aim to save time

D — Reduce the dose
खुराक कम करने के लिए: It does not change the dose

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Pull the skin sideways before injection and release it after withdrawal to create the sealed track
option_1:
Prevent leakage of the drug into subcutaneous tissue
दवा को चमड़े के नीचे रिसने से रोकने के लिए
option_2:
Avoid using gloves
दस्ताने से बचने के लिए
option_3:

option_4:

question:
The most important measure to prevent infection in a patient with a tracheostomy is:

ट्रैकियोस्टोमी वाले रोगी में संक्रमण रोकने का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण उपाय क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Strict hand hygiene and aseptic suctioning and cleaning
कड़ी हाथ-सफाई तथा बंध्य सक्शन और सफाई

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Hand hygiene with aseptic suctioning and cleaning prevents infection of the tracheostomy

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Avoiding humidification
नमी से बचना: Humidification keeps secretions thin

B — Using the same inner cannula for days
कई दिनों तक वही भीतरी नली प्रयोग करना: Reusing a soiled cannula spreads infection

C — Covering the stoma tightly
स्टोमा को कसकर ढँकना: A tight cover blocks the airway and traps secretions

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Clean the inner cannula regularly and keep suction and spare tubes ready at the bedside
option_2:
Using the same inner cannula for days
कई दिनों तक वही भीतरी नली प्रयोग करना
option_3:
Covering the stoma tightly
स्टोमा को कसकर ढँकना
option_4:
Strict hand hygiene and aseptic suctioning and cleaning
कड़ी हाथ-सफाई तथा बंध्य सक्शन और सफाई

question:
During adult CPR the chest should be compressed to a depth of about:

वयस्क सीपीआर में छाती को लगभग कितनी गहराई तक दबाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 5 to 6 cm
5 से 6 से.मी.

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Adult compressions are given to a depth of about 5 to 6 cm

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 10 cm
10 से.मी.: 10 cm risks injury

B — 1 to 2 cm
1 से 2 से.मी.: 1 to 2 cm is far too shallow

C — 8 cm
8 से.मी.: 8 cm is excessive

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Allow full recoil and combine compressions with rescue breaths and early defibrillation

question:
When removing personal protective equipment, the nurse should remove the:

व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षा उपकरण उतारते समय नर्स को सबसे पहले क्या उतारना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Gloves first, then the gown, then the mask with hand hygiene between steps
पहले दस्ताने, फिर गाउन, फिर मास्क, बीच में हाथ-सफाई के साथ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Gloves are removed first, then the gown, then the mask, with hand hygiene at each step

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Mask first
पहले मास्क: The mask is removed last

B — Nothing in particular
कोई विशेष क्रम नहीं: A fixed order prevents self-contamination

C — Gown before gloves
दस्ताने से पहले गाउन: Removing the gown before the gloves contaminates the arms

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Remove equipment without touching the outer contaminated surface
option_4:
Gloves first, then the gown, then the mask with hand hygiene between steps

question:
While caring for the body after death, the nurse should:

मृत्यु के बाद शरीर की देखभाल करते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Close the eyes and mouth, straighten the limbs and show respect and dignity
आँखें और मुँह बंद करें, अंग सीधे करें और सम्मान बनाए रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The body is cared for with dignity, the eyes and mouth are closed, and the limbs are straightened

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Leave the eyes and mouth open
आँखें और मुँह खुले छोड़ दें: Leaving the eyes and mouth open shows a lack of respect

C — Discuss loudly nearby
पास में जोर से बात करें: Quiet respect is maintained

D — Remove identification
पहचान हटा दें: Identification is kept until the formalities are complete

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Support the grieving family and follow the unit's cultural and religious practices
option_1:
Leave the eyes and mouth open
आँखें और मुँह खुले छोड़ दें
option_2:
Close the eyes and mouth, straighten the limbs and show respect and dignity
आँखें और मुँह बंद करें, अंग सीधे करें और सम्मान बनाए रखें
option_3:
Discuss loudly nearby
पास में जोर से बात करें

question:
Menopause is defined as:

रजोनिवृत्ति की परिभाषा क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. The permanent cessation of menstruation
मासिक धर्म का स्थायी बंद होना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Menopause is the permanent end of menstruation, usually between 45 and 55 years

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Irregular periods in teenage
किशोरावस्था में अनियमित मासिक धर्म: Teenage irregularity is different

C — Painful periods
दर्दभरे मासिक धर्म: Painful periods are dysmenorrhoea

D — The first menstruation
पहला मासिक धर्म: The first period is menarche

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Hot flushes, mood changes and bone loss are common, so calcium and exercise are encouraged
option_1:
Irregular periods in teenage
किशोरावस्था में अनियमित मासिक धर्म
option_2:
The permanent cessation of menstruation
मासिक धर्म का स्थायी बंद होना

question:
Folic acid is given before and during early pregnancy mainly to prevent:

गर्भावस्था से पहले और आरंभ में फोलिक एसिड मुख्यतः किसे रोकने के लिए दिया जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Neural tube defects in the baby
शिशु में न्यूरल ट्यूब दोष

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Folic acid taken before conception and in early pregnancy prevents neural tube defects such as spina bifida

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Pre-eclampsia
प्री-एक्लेम्पसिया: It does not prevent pre-eclampsia

C — Anaemia only
केवल खून की कमी: Iron prevents anaemia, not the tube defect

D — Gestational diabetes
गर्भकालीन मधुमेह: Folic acid does not prevent diabetes

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Supplementation should begin before conception, because the neural tube closes in the first weeks
option_1:
Neural tube defects in the baby
शिशु में न्यूरल ट्यूब दोष

question:
On a partograph, cervical dilatation crossing the alert line indicates:

पार्टोग्राफ पर गर्भाशय ग्रीवा का खुलना अलर्ट रेखा को पार कर जाए तो क्या दर्शाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Slow progress needing assessment and possible action
धीमी प्रगति जिसके लिए मूल्यांकन और संभवतः कार्रवाई आवश्यक है

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Crossing the alert line signals slow progress, so the cause is assessed and action taken

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Labour is complete
प्रसव पूरा हो गया: Completion is shown by full dilatation and delivery

B — Normal progress
सामान्य प्रगति: Normal progress stays left of the alert line

C — No action is needed
किसी कार्रवाई की आवश्यकता नहीं: Action is required, not inaction

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: The partograph is a simple tool that helps detect obstructed labour early
option_3:
No action is needed
किसी कार्रवाई की आवश्यकता नहीं

question:
Tetanus toxoid is given in pregnancy to:

गर्भावस्था में टिटनेस टॉक्सॉइड क्यों दिया जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Protect the mother and the newborn from tetanus
माँ और नवजात को टिटनेस से बचाने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Maternal immunisation protects both the mother and the newborn from tetanus

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Prevent malaria
मलेरिया रोकने के लिए: It does not prevent malaria

B — Treat anaemia
खून की कमी का इलाज: Anaemia is treated with iron and folic acid

C — Lower blood pressure
रक्तचाप कम करने के लिए: It does not affect blood pressure

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: The newborn is protected through the antibodies passed before birth
option_3:
Lower blood pressure
रक्तचाप कम करने के लिए
option_4:
Protect the mother and the newborn from tetanus
माँ और नवजात को टिटनेस से बचाने के लिए

question:
An excessive amount of amniotic fluid is called:

अम्नीओटिक द्रव की अधिक मात्रा को क्या कहते हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Polyhydramnios
पॉलीहाइड्रम्नियोस

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Polyhydramnios is an excess of amniotic fluid

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Oligohydramnios
ओलिगोहाइड्रम्नियोस: Oligohydramnios is a deficiency of fluid

B — Hydatidiform mole
हाइडेटिडिफॉर्म मोल: A hydatidiform mole is an abnormal growth

C — Ectopic pregnancy
एक्टोपिक गर्भावस्था: An ectopic pregnancy is outside the uterus

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Polyhydramnios is linked to diabetes and fetal anomalies, so both are assessed

question:
Five days after delivery a mother has a red, painful, hot area on one breast with fever. The nurse should:

प्रसव के पाँच दिन बाद माँ के एक स्तन पर लाल, दर्दभरा, गर्म क्षेत्र और बुखार है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Continue feeding from both breasts, empty the affected breast and report for prescribed antibiotics
दोनों स्तनों से दूध पिलाना जारी रखें, प्रभावित स्तन खाली करें और निर्धारित एंटीबायोटिक के लिए रिपोर्ट करें

A — Stop breastfeeding completely
स्तनपान पूरी तरह बंद कर दें: Stopping feeding worsens engorgement and infection

B — Bind the breast tightly
स्तन को कसकर बाँधें: Tight binding blocks ducts

D — Apply cold packs only
केवल ठंडी पट्टियाँ लगाएँ: Cold alone does not treat the infection

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Warm compresses before feeds and analgesia help, and the milk remains safe for the baby

option_4:

question:

स्तनपान के दौरान सही जुड़ाव कब दिखता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. The baby takes the nipple and much of the areola into the mouth with the chin touching the breast
शिशु निप्पल और एरिओला का बड़ा भाग मुँह में ले और ठोड़ी स्तन से लगी हो

मुँह में केवल निप्पल हो: Nipple-only attachment causes pain and poor milk flow

शिशु के गाल अंदर धँसे हों: Sucked-in cheeks mean poor attachment

option_1:

मुँह में केवल निप्पल हो

शिशु के गाल अंदर धँसे हों

question:
Unopened insulin vials should be stored:

बंद इंसुलिन की शीशियाँ कैसे रखनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. In the refrigerator at 2 to 8 degrees Celsius
2 से 8 डिग्री सेल्सियस पर रेफ्रिजरेटर में

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Unopened insulin is kept refrigerated at 2 to 8 degrees Celsius

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — In the freezer
फ्रीज़र में: Freezing destroys insulin

B — In direct sunlight
सीधी धूप में: Sunlight and heat damage insulin

C — In hot water
गर्म पानी में: Hot water destroys it

💎 PNC Pearl: The vial in use may be kept at room temperature for up to about a month, away from heat and sunlight
option_4:
In the refrigerator at 2 to 8 degrees Celsius
2 से 8 डिग्री सेल्सियस पर रेफ्रिजरेटर में

question:
A patient on a calcium channel blocker such as amlodipine should be warned about:

एम्लोडिपिन जैसी कैल्शियम चैनल ब्लॉकर ले रहे रोगी को किसके बारे में चेतावनी देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Ankle swelling and dizziness
टखनों में सूजन और चक्कर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Ankle oedema and dizziness from vasodilatation are common side effects

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Hearing loss
सुनने में कमी: Hearing loss is not typical

B — Hair loss
बाल झड़ना: Hair loss is not typical

C — Increased appetite
भूख बढ़ना: Increased appetite is not typical

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Advise rising slowly, because the blood pressure may fall on standing
option_4:
Ankle swelling and dizziness
टखनों में सूजन और चक्कर

question:
The most dangerous side effect of morphine to watch for is:

मॉर्फिन का सबसे खतरनाक दुष्प्रभाव जिस पर ध्यान देना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Respiratory depression
श्वसन अवसाद

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Respiratory depression is the most dangerous effect and must be watched closely

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Nausea
जी मिचलाना: Nausea is common but not life-threatening

कब्ज: Constipation is common but not the most dangerous

नींद आना: Drowsiness is expected and less serious

question:
Isoniazid can cause peripheral neuropathy, which is prevented by giving:

आइसोनियाज़िड से परिधीय तंत्रिका-शोथ हो सकता है, जिसे किसके द्वारा रोका जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Pyridoxine (vitamin B6)
पाइरिडॉक्सिन (विटामिन बी6)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Pyridoxine is given with isoniazid to prevent peripheral neuropathy

कैल्शियम: Calcium does not prevent it

विटामिन सी: Vitamin C does not prevent it

विटामिन के: Vitamin K relates to clotting

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Warn the patient to report tingling or numbness in the hands and feet promptly

question:
A common side effect of chloroquine that patients should be told about is:

क्लोरोक्वीन का एक सामान्य दुष्प्रभाव जिसके बारे में रोगी को बताना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Nausea and itching
जी मिचलाना और खुजली

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Nausea and itching are common side effects of chloroquine

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Constipation
कब्ज: Constipation is not typical

B — Weight gain
वजन बढ़ना: Weight gain is unrelated

D — Polyuria
अधिक मूत्र: Polyuria is unrelated

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Itching may be more troublesome in darker skin, and the patient can be reassured that it is not dangerous

question:
The male sterilisation procedure is called:

पुरुष नसबंदी की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहते हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Vasectomy
वासेक्टॉमी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Vasectomy is the male sterilisation procedure in which the vas deferens is tied

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Hysterectomy
हिस्टेरेक्टॉमी: Hysterectomy is removal of the uterus

C — Laparotomy
लैपरोटॉमी: Laparotomy is opening the abdomen

D — Tubectomy
ट्यूबेक्टॉमी: Tubectomy is the female sterilisation procedure

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Vasectomy is a permanent method, so proper counselling is essential before the procedure

question:
The most important measure to prevent food-borne illness in the community is:

समुदाय में खाद्य-जनित रोग रोकने का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण उपाय क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Safe handling, cooking and covered storage of food
भोजन को सुरक्षित रूप से संभालना, पकाना और ढँककर रखना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Safe handling, thorough cooking and covered storage prevent food-borne illness

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Avoiding all cooked food
सभी पका भोजन छोड़ देना: Cooked food is not avoided

C — Eating more spices
अधिक मसाले खाना: Spices do not make food safe

D — Drinking less water
कम पानी पीना: Adequate clean water is essential

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Wash hands before cooking and eating, and keep cooked and raw foods separate
option_1:
Safe handling, cooking and covered storage of food
भोजन को सुरक्षित रूप से संभालना, पकाना और ढँककर रखना
option_2:
Avoiding all cooked food
सभी पका भोजन छोड़ देना

question:
For health education to succeed, the message should be:

स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा सफल होने के लिए संदेश कैसा होना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Simple, relevant and understandable to the people
सरल, प्रासंगिक और लोगों के लिए समझने योग्य

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Health messages work best when they are simple, relevant and understandable

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Given only once
केवल एक बार दिया जाए: Repetition reinforces learning

C — Only in writing
केवल लिखित रूप में: Various methods are used, not only writing

D — Complex and technical
जटिल और तकनीकी: Complex technical language confuses people

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Involve the community and use local examples, and check that the message has been understood
option_1:
Given only once
केवल एक बार दिया जाए
option_2:
Simple, relevant and understandable to the people
सरल, प्रासंगिक और लोगों के लिए समझने योग्य

question:
Community participation in health programmes means:

स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रमों में समुदाय की भागीदारी का मतलब क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. People actively take part in planning and running their own health activities
लोग अपनी स्वास्थ्य गतिविधियों की योजना और संचालन में सक्रिय रूप से भाग लें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Community participation means people take an active part in their own health activities

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — The community gives only money
समुदाय केवल पैसा दे: Participation is more than money

B — Health workers work alone
स्वास्थ्य कर्मी अकेले काम करें: Working alone limits success

C — Only the government plans everything
केवल सरकार सब कुछ योजना बनाए: Programmes succeed best with community involvement

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Involved communities sustain health programmes long after outside support ends
option_1:
The community gives only money
समुदाय केवल पैसा दे
option_2:
Health workers work alone
स्वास्थ्य कर्मी अकेले काम करें
option_3:
Only the government plans everything
केवल सरकार सब कुछ योजना बनाए
option_4:
People actively take part in planning and running their own health activities
लोग अपनी स्वास्थ्य गतिविधियों की योजना और संचालन में सक्रिय रूप से भाग लें

question:
The priority health problem in the elderly that increases the risk of fractures is:

वृद्ध लोगों में कौन-सी प्रमुख स्वास्थ्य समस्या हड्डी टूटने का खतरा बढ़ाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Osteoporosis
ऑस्टियोपोरोसिस

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Osteoporosis reduces bone density and makes fractures more likely in the elderly

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Tinnitus
कान में आवाज़: Tinnitus is ringing in the ears

B — Presbyopia
दृष्टि-दोष: Presbyopia affects near vision

D — Constipation
कब्ज: Constipation is common but does not cause fractures

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Calcium, vitamin D and safe mobility help prevent falls and fractures in older people

question:
A disease that is constantly present in a population is said to be:

जो रोग किसी आबादी में लगातार मौजूद रहता है उसे क्या कहते हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Endemic
स्थानिक

🧠 Clinical Rationale: An endemic disease is constantly present in a population or area

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Epidemic
महामारी: An epidemic is a sudden increase above the expected level

C — Sporadic
छिटपुट: A sporadic case occurs occasionally and irregularly

D — Pandemic
विश्वव्यापी महामारी: A pandemic spreads across countries or continents

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: The same disease can be endemic in one place and epidemic in another

question:
The first milk teeth usually appear at the age of about:

पहले दूध के दाँत सामान्यतः किस उम्र में आते हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 6 to 8 months
6 से 8 महीने

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The first milk teeth usually appear at about 6 to 8 months

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 4 years
4 वर्ष: Milk teeth are complete well before 4 years

B — 2 years
2 वर्ष: By 2 years many milk teeth have appeared

C — 1 to 2 months
1 से 2 महीने: Teeth rarely appear at 1 to 2 months

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Teething may cause mild gum discomfort but not high fever, which needs another cause

question:
A baby with colic cries for long periods in the evening. The nurse should advise the mother to:

दूध पीने वाले शिशु को शाम को लंबे समय तक दर्दभरी रोना होता है। नर्स को माँ को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Burp the baby well, hold it upright and comfort it calmly
शिशु को अच्छी तरह डकार दिलाएँ, सीधा पकड़ें और शांति से तसल्ली दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Good burping, an upright position and calm comforting help a baby with colic

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Stop breastfeeding
स्तनपान बंद कर दें: Breastfeeding is continued

C — Give strong sedatives
तेज़ नींद की दवा दें: Sedatives are not given to infants casually

D — Feed very fast
बहुत तेज़ी से दूध पिलाएँ: Fast feeding increases air swallowing

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Colic usually settles by the age of three to four months, and reassurance supports the mother
option_1:
Burp the baby well, hold it upright and comfort it calmly
शिशु को अच्छी तरह डकार दिलाएँ, सीधा पकड़ें और शांति से तसल्ली दें
option_3:
Give strong sedatives
तेज़ नींद की दवा दें
option_4:
Feed very fast
बहुत तेज़ी से दूध पिलाएँ

question:
A child has delayed motor milestones with stiffness of the limbs and poor head control since birth. This most likely indicates:

बच्चे में जन्म से ही गति-क्षमता में देरी, अंगों की कठोरता और सिर नियंत्रित न होना है। यह सर्वाधिक किस ओर संकेत करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Cerebral palsy
सेरेब्रल पाल्सी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Delayed motor milestones with limb stiffness and poor head control suggest cerebral palsy

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Colour blindness
वर्णांधता: Colour blindness affects colour perception

C — Simple knock knees
साधारण नॉक नीज़: Knock knees affect the legs only in older children

D — Dental caries
दाँतों की सड़न: Dental caries affects the teeth

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Early physiotherapy and family support improve the child's function and independence

question:
A breastfed newborn has mild jaundice on the third day. The nurse should:

स्तनपान करने वाले नवजात में तीसरे दिन हल्का पीलिया है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Increase the frequency of feeds and monitor the bilirubin
भोजन की बारंबारता बढ़ाएँ और बिलीरुबिन की निगरानी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: More frequent feeds help clear the bilirubin, and the level is monitored

🔍 Key Clues: newborn

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Stop breastfeeding at once
स्तनपान तुरंत बंद कर दें: Stopping breastfeeding is not needed and can reduce milk supply

B — Give only water
केवल पानी दें: Water does not help clear bilirubin

D — Ignore the jaundice
पीलिया को नजरअंदाज करें: Jaundice must be monitored because it can worsen

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Breastfeeding jaundice is usually mild; only very high levels need phototherapy
option_1:
Stop breastfeeding at once
स्तनपान तुरंत बंद कर दें
option_3:
Increase the frequency of feeds and monitor the bilirubin
भोजन की बारंबारता बढ़ाएँ और बिलीरुबिन की निगरानी करें

question:
A toddler holds his breath and turns blue after crying hard. The nurse should advise the parents to:

एक छोटा बच्चा जोर से रोने के बाद साँस रोककर नीला पड़ जाता है। नर्स को माता-पिता को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Stay calm, keep the child safe and not give extra attention to the behaviour
शांत रहें, बच्चे को सुरक्षित रखें और व्यवहार पर अतिरिक्त ध्यान न दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Staying calm, ensuring safety and avoiding reinforcement reduce breath-holding spells

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Punish the child
बच्चे को दंड दें: Punishment worsens distress and is harmful

C — Shake the child strongly
बच्चे को जोर से हिलाएँ: Vigorous shaking is dangerous

D — Give more sweets
अधिक मिठाई दें: Sweets are unrelated

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: These spells are frightening but usually harmless, and children outgrow them
option_2:
Stay calm, keep the child safe and not give extra attention to the behaviour
शांत रहें, बच्चे को सुरक्षित रखें और व्यवहार पर अतिरिक्त ध्यान न दें
option_3:
Shake the child strongly
बच्चे को जोर से हिलाएँ

question:
Blood pressure is produced mainly by the pumping action of the:

रक्तचाप मुख्यतः किसकी पंपिंग क्रिया से बनता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Heart
हृदय

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The pumping of the heart creates the pressure that drives blood through the vessels

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Kidney
गुर्दा: The kidney filters blood

C — Liver
यकृत: The liver does not pump blood

D — Lungs
फेफड़े: The lungs oxygenate blood

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Blood pressure depends on the heart's output and the resistance of the vessels

question:
Vital capacity is the maximum volume of air that can be:

जीवन-क्षमता वायु की वह अधिकतम मात्रा है जिसे:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Breathed out after the deepest possible breath in
गहरी से गहरी साँस लेने के बाद बाहर छोड़ी जा सके

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Vital capacity is the maximum amount of air expelled after the deepest inspiration

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Held in the lungs at rest
आराम से फेफड़ों में रोका जा सके: The air held at rest is the functional residual capacity

C — Left in the lungs after full expiration
पूरी साँस छोड़ने के बाद फेफड़ों में बची रहे: The air left after full expiration is the residual volume

D — Breathed out in one second
एक सेकंड में बाहर छोड़ी जा सके: The volume in one second is the forced expiratory volume

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Vital capacity is reduced in restrictive lung disease and measured with a spirometer
option_1:
Breathed out after the deepest possible breath in
गहरी से गहरी साँस लेने के बाद बाहर छोड़ी जा सके
option_2:
Held in the lungs at rest
आराम से फेफड़ों में रोका जा सके
option_3:
Left in the lungs after full expiration
पूरी साँस छोड़ने के बाद फेफड़ों में बची रहे
option_4:
Breathed out in one second
एक सेकंड में बाहर छोड़ी जा सके

question:
Which mineral is essential for the strength of bone?

हड्डी की मजबूती के लिए कौन-सा खनिज आवश्यक है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Calcium
कैल्शियम

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Calcium, with phosphate, gives bone its strength and hardness

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Iodine
आयोडीन: Iodine is needed for thyroid hormones

C — Iron
लोहा: Iron is needed for haemoglobin

D — Sodium
सोडियम: Sodium helps regulate fluids

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Vitamin D is needed for calcium absorption, so a deficiency weakens the bones

question:
The structure that carries impulses away from the nerve cell body is the:

जो संरचना तंत्रिका कोशिका-काय से आवेग दूर ले जाती है वह कौन-सी है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Axon
एक्सॉन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The axon carries impulses away from the cell body

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Dendrite
डेन्ड्राइट: Dendrites carry impulses towards the cell body

B — Myelin sheath
माइलिन आवरण: The myelin sheath insulates the axon and speeds conduction

D — Synapse
सिनैप्स: A synapse is the junction between two neurons

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Damage to the myelin sheath slows nerve conduction, as seen in some neurological diseases

question:
Insulin is secreted by which cells of the pancreas?

इंसुलिन अग्न्याशय की किन कोशिकाओं से स्रवित होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Beta cells of the islets of Langerhans
लैंगरहैंस द्वीपों की बीटा कोशिकाएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Insulin is secreted by the beta cells of the islets of Langerhans

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Acinar cells
एसिनर कोशिकाएँ: Acinar cells secrete digestive enzymes

B — Liver cells
यकृत कोशिकाएँ: Liver cells store glycogen

D — Adrenal cells
अधिवृक्क कोशिकाएँ: Adrenal cells secrete other hormones

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Destruction of beta cells causes type 1 diabetes, needing insulin replacement
option_3:
Beta cells of the islets of Langerhans
लैंगरहैंस द्वीपों की बीटा कोशिकाएँ

question:
A child who cannot sit still, is easily distracted and acts impulsively most likely has:

जो बच्चा शांत नहीं बैठ पाता, जल्दी ध्यान भटकता है और आवेगपूर्वक कार्य करता है, उसमें सर्वाधिक क्या संभावित है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
अटेंशन डेफिसिट हाइपरैक्टिविटी डिसऑर्डर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Inattention, hyperactivity and impulsivity suggest attention deficit hyperactivity disorder

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Mental retardation only
केवल मानसिक मंदता: Intellectual disability is a different condition

C — Autism only
केवल ऑटिज़्म: Autism mainly affects social interaction and communication

D — Normal behaviour
सामान्य व्यवहार: These features interfere with daily life

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Structured routine, behavioural therapy and family support help the child, with drugs used only when prescribed
option_2:
Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
अटेंशन डेफिसिट हाइपरैक्टिविटी डिसऑर्डर

question:
A patient suddenly loses the ability to move a leg, but all tests are normal. The nurse should:

रोगी अचानक एक पैर हिला नहीं पाता, पर सभी जाँचें सामान्य हैं। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Accept the symptom supportively and encourage the patient without confrontation
लक्षण को सहानुभूतिपूर्वक स्वीकारें और बिना टकराव के रोगी को प्रोत्साहित करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Conversion symptoms are managed supportively without confrontation, since the distress is real

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Force the patient to walk
रोगी को चलने के लिए बाध्य करें: Forcing movement increases resistance

C — Accuse the patient of pretending
रोगी पर नाटक करने का आरोप लगाएँ: Accusation damages trust and therapy

D — Ignore the patient
रोगी को नजरअंदाज करें: Ignoring the patient is unhelpful

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: The symptoms are not deliberately produced, and a supportive approach with therapy helps recovery
option_1:
Force the patient to walk
रोगी को चलने के लिए बाध्य करें
option_2:
Accept the symptom supportively and encourage the patient without confrontation
लक्षण को सहानुभूतिपूर्वक स्वीकारें और बिना टकराव के रोगी को प्रोत्साहित करें
option_3:
Accuse the patient of pretending
रोगी पर नाटक करने का आरोप लगाएँ

question:
The first step in crisis intervention is to:

संकट हस्तक्षेप का पहला चरण क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Assess the safety of the patient and the precipitating problem
रोगी की सुरक्षा और संकट के कारण का मूल्यांकन करना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Safety and an assessment of the problem come first in a crisis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give advice quickly
तुरंत सलाह देना: Rapid advice without assessment is unhelpful

B — Prescribe medicines
दवाएँ लिखना: Medicines are not the first step

D — Refer the patient at once
रोगी को तुरंत भेज देना: Immediate referral skips the essential assessment

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.
